observations.body: Peter follows at a distance and sits among those gathered around a fire.
observations.label: Distance

observations.body: A servant girl, another person, and another man identify Peter through association, group, and speech.
observations.label: Three identifications

observations.body: The final denial is followed by the Lord’s look, Peter’s memory, departure, and bitter weeping.
observations.label: Look and memory

payload.posture: Keep each accuser, response, interval, and final sequence attached to Luke’s telling.
payload.tension: Peter remains physically near enough to see the Lord while repeatedly denying the relationship being named.
payload.title: The Lord turned and looked
